routes.title: Vega Lyrae VTuber, Music & Experimental Tech | Vega Lyrae VTuber, Developer & Music Producer

routes.description: Explore Vega Lyrae’s technical portfolio, including software engineering, AI agents, systems infrastructure, synthetic voice research, and ongoing robotics development.

routes.title: Contact & Partnerships Vega Lyrae | Vega Lyrae VTuber, Developer & Music Producer
routes.description: Contact Vega Lyrae about brand sponsorships, AI and robotics collaboration, indie games, music technology, and professional opportunities.
